640-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2557-4365-6664-6753-7942.description:

When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Repeat.

4399-4518-7646-7818.description:

Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-7646-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

5195-7431-7487.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Zealous Lorecaster

Resolve Daydream, blinking Zealous Lorecaster
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

You have a nonland card in hand.

Sakashima the Impostor triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1, and repeat from step 1 as able.
804-1525-4254-7115-7117.notes: You need to have both an Avatar Aang and an Aang, Master of Elements on the battlefield. This combo only reduces the mana cost of spells to {0} - it doesn't negate additional costs or targets those spells may require.

Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1322-3457-5921-5970.description:

Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.

645-2060-2511-3750-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-2511-3750-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

2073-2267-6808.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 13 or higher.
You control a creature with power 2 or greater.
2073-2267-6808.description:
Activate The Last Ride's crew ability by tapping a creature with power 2 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
The Last Ride dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3605-5145-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1357-4697-5026.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
1357-4697-5026.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
1357-4697-5026.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

2530-2577-3330-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-3330-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.

Repeat.

Cast Saving Grace by paying {1}{W}.
Saving Grace enters the battlefield attached to Crystalline Crawler, triggering itself, causing all damage that would be dealt to you or permanents you control this turn to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.

Saving Grace's ability redirects damage to Crystalline Crawler, which results in at least four +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability at least once by removing at least one +1/+1 counter from it, adding at least {B}.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Channeler Initiate by paying {1}{G}.
Channeler Initiate enters the battlefield with a vigilance counter, putting three -1/-1 counters on itself.
Activate Channeler Initiate by tapping and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing all counters from Channeler Initiate.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Channeler Initiate, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tayam ability, milling three cards and returning Channeler Initiate from your graveyard to the battlefield.
